## Button
Category: Primitive
A clickable button control with optional icon, loading state, and severity/size/style modifiers.
### ng API
- `label`: string | undefined
- `icon`: string | undefined
- `iconPos`: "left" | "right" | "top" | "bottom"
- `loading`: boolean
- `disabled`: boolean
- `severity`: string | undefined
- `raised`: boolean
- `rounded`: boolean
- `text`: boolean
- `outlined`: boolean
- `size`: "small" | "large" | undefined
- `fluid`: boolean
### react API
- `label`: string | undefined
- `icon`: React.ReactNode
- `iconPos`: "left" | "right" | "top" | "bottom"
- `loading`: boolean
- `loadingIcon`: React.ReactNode
- `disabled`: boolean
- `severity`: "secondary" | "success" | "info" | "warning" | "danger" | "help" | "contrast" | undefined
- `size`: "small" | "large" | undefined
- `text`: boolean | undefined
- `raised`: boolean | undefined
- `rounded`: boolean | undefined
- `outlined`: boolean | undefined
- `link`: boolean | undefined
- `plain`: boolean | undefined
- `badge`: string | undefined
- `badgeClassName`: string | undefined
- `visible`: boolean
- `tooltip`: string | undefined
- `tooltipOptions`: Record<string, unknown> | undefined
### vue API
- `label`: String
- `icon`: String
- `iconPos`: String
- `iconClass`: [String, Object]
- `badge`: String
- `badgeClass`: [String, Object]
- `badgeSeverity`: String
- `loading`: Boolean
- `loadingIcon`: String
- `as`: [String, Object]
- `asChild`: Boolean
- `link`: Boolean
- `severity`: String
- `raised`: Boolean
- `rounded`: Boolean
- `text`: Boolean
- `outlined`: Boolean
- `size`: String
- `variant`: String
- `plain`: Boolean
- `fluid`: Boolean
- `ariaLabel`: String
- `tooltip`: String
- `tooltipOptions`: Object

## Checkbox
Category: Form
A boolean input control rendered as a native checkbox, with an optional text label.
### ng API
- `binary`: boolean
- `label`: string | undefined
### react API
- `checked`: unknown
- `trueValue`: unknown
- `falseValue`: unknown
- `disabled`: boolean
- `readOnly`: boolean
- `invalid`: boolean
- `name`: string | undefined
- `value`: unknown
- `id`: string | undefined
- `inputId`: string | undefined
- `tooltip`: string | undefined
- `tooltipOptions`: Record<string, unknown> | undefined
- `autoFocus`: boolean
- `className`: string | undefined
- event `onChange` (callback-prop)
### vue API
- `value`: any
- `binary`: Boolean
- `indeterminate`: Boolean
- `trueValue`: any
- `falseValue`: any
- `disabled`: Boolean
- `readonly`: Boolean
- `required`: Boolean
- `tabindex`: Number
- `inputId`: String
- `inputClass`: [String, Object]
- `inputStyle`: Object
- `ariaLabelledby`: String
- `ariaLabel`: String
- `invalid`: Boolean
- `name`: String
- event `change` (emit)

## Dialog
Category: Overlay
A modal (or non-modal) overlay window that renders projected content above the page, with focus trapping and Escape-key dismissal.
### ng API
- `visible`: boolean
- `header`: string | undefined
- `closable`: boolean
- `closeOnEscape`: boolean
- `modal`: boolean
- event `visibleChange` (output)
- event `onShow` (output)
- event `onHide` (output)
### react API
- `visible`: boolean
- `header`: React.ReactNode
- `footer`: React.ReactNode
- `children`: React.ReactNode
- `modal`: boolean
- `closable`: boolean
- `showCloseIcon`: boolean
- `closeOnEscape`: boolean
- `dismissableMask`: boolean
- `blockScroll`: boolean
- `baseZIndex`: number | undefined
- `appendTo`: HTMLElement | (() => HTMLElement) | undefined
- `className`: string | undefined
- `style`: React.CSSProperties | undefined
- `id`: string | undefined
- `focusOnShow`: boolean
- event `onHide` (callback-prop)
### vue API
- `visible`: Boolean
- `header`: String
- `footer`: String
- `modal`: Boolean
- `closable`: Boolean
- `closeOnEscape`: Boolean
- `dismissableMask`: Boolean
- `blockScroll`: Boolean
- `baseZIndex`: Number
- `autoZIndex`: Boolean
- `position`: String
- `appendTo`: [String, Object]
- `ariaCloseLabel`: String
- event `update:visible` (emit)
- event `show` (emit)
- event `hide` (emit)

## Menu
Category: Navigation
A flat navigation/command list rendered as an ARIA menu, either inline or (React/Vue only) as a popup overlay, with roving-tabindex keyboard navigation.
### ng API
- `model`: UMenuItem[]
- `popup`: boolean
### react API
- `model`: UMenuItem[]
- `popup`: boolean
- `popupAlignment`: "left" | "right" | undefined
- `id`: string | undefined
- `ariaLabel`: string | undefined
- `ariaLabelledBy`: string | undefined
- `className`: string | undefined
- `style`: React.CSSProperties | undefined
- `baseZIndex`: number | undefined
- `appendTo`: HTMLElement | (() => HTMLElement) | undefined
- `closeOnEscape`: boolean
- event `onShow` (callback-prop)
- event `onHide` (callback-prop)
### vue API
- `model`: Array
- `popup`: Boolean
- `appendTo`: [String, Object]
- `autoZIndex`: Boolean
- `baseZIndex`: Number
- `tabindex`: Number
- `ariaLabel`: String
- `ariaLabelledby`: String
- event `show` (emit)
- event `hide` (emit)

## Paginator
Category: Data
A page-navigation control (first/prev/next/last plus numbered page links) driven by first/rows/totalRecords, used standalone or composed inside Table/DataView for paging.
### ng API
- `first`: number
- `rows`: number
- `totalRecords`: number
- `pageLinkSize`: number
- event `onPageChange` (output)
### react API
- `first`: number
- `rows`: number
- `totalRecords`: number
- `pageLinkSize`: number
- event `onPageChange` (callback-prop)
### vue API
- `first`: Number
- `rows`: Number
- `totalRecords`: Number
- `pageLinkSize`: Number
- event `page` (emit)
- event `update:first` (emit)
- event `update:rows` (emit)

## Scroller
Category: Data
A virtual-scroll windowing primitive that renders only the items currently within (plus a tolerated buffer around) the visible viewport, used internally by Table and other large-list components rather than directly by end users.
### ng API
- `items`: unknown[]
- `itemSize`: number
- `numToleratedItems`: number | undefined
- `loading`: boolean | undefined
- `disabled`: boolean
- `lazy`: boolean
- event `onLazyLoad` (output)
### react API
- `items`: unknown[]
- `itemSize`: number
- `numToleratedItems`: number
- `disabled`: boolean
- `lazy`: boolean
- `loading`: boolean
- event `onLazyLoad` (callback-prop)
### vue API
- `items`: Array
- `itemSize`: Number
- `numToleratedItems`: Number
- `disabled`: Boolean
- `loading`: Boolean
- `lazy`: Boolean
- event `lazy-load` (emit)

## Table
Category: Data
Table renders tabular data with sorting, filtering, selection, pagination, virtualization, and row/cell editing.
### ng API
- `value`: T[]
- `dataKey`: string
- `columns`: { field: string; header: string }[]
- `sortMode`: SortMode
- `sortField`: string | undefined
- `sortOrder`: 1 | 0 | -1
- `multiSortMeta`: SortMeta[]
- `filters`: Record<string, FilterMetadata | FilterMetadata[]>
- `selectionMode`: SelectionMode | undefined
- `selection`: T | T[] | undefined
- `compareSelectionBy`: "equals" | "deepEquals"
- `paginator`: boolean
- `first`: number
- `rows`: number
- `totalRecords`: number
- `rowsPerPageOptions`: number[] | undefined
- `virtualScroll`: boolean
- `virtualScrollItemSize`: number
- `lazy`: boolean
- `lazyLoadOnInit`: boolean
- `editMode`: "cell" | "row" | undefined
- `editingRowKeys`: Record<string, boolean>
- `rowGroupMode`: "subheader" | "rowspan" | undefined
- `groupRowsBy`: string | undefined
- event `sortFieldChange` (output)
- event `selectionChange` (output)
- event `firstChange` (output)
### react API
- `value`: T[]
- `dataKey`: string
- `columns`: UTableColumn[]
- `sortMode`: SortMode
- `sortField`: string
- `sortOrder`: 1 | 0 | -1
- `multiSortMeta`: SortMeta[]
- `filters`: Record<string, FilterMetadata | { operator: "and" | "or"; constraints: FilterMetadata[] }>
- `selectionMode`: SelectionMode | undefined
- `selection`: T | T[] | undefined
- `compareSelectionBy`: "equals" | "deepEquals"
- `paginator`: boolean
- `first`: number
- `rows`: number
- `totalRecords`: number
- `virtualScrollerOptions`: { itemSize: number } | undefined
- `lazy`: boolean | undefined
- `editMode`: "cell" | "row" | undefined
- `editingRows`: Record<string, boolean> | undefined
- `rowGroupMode`: "subheader" | "rowspan" | undefined
- `groupRowsBy`: string | undefined
- event `onSort` (callback-prop)
- event `onSelectionChange` (callback-prop)
- event `onPage` (callback-prop)
### vue API
- `value`: Array
- `dataKey`: String
- `columns`: Array
- `sortMode`: String
- `sortField`: String
- `sortOrder`: Number
- `multiSortMeta`: Array
- `filters`: Object
- `selectionMode`: String
- `selection`: [Object, Array]
- `compareSelectionBy`: String
- `paginator`: Boolean
- `first`: Number
- `rows`: Number
- `totalRecords`: Number
- `rowsPerPageOptions`: Array
- `virtualScrollerOptions`: Object
- `lazy`: Boolean
- `editMode`: String
- `editingRows`: Array
- `rowGroupMode`: String
- `groupRowsBy`: String
- event `sort` (emit)
- event `selection-change` (emit)
- event `page` (emit)
### Accessibility
Roles: table, rowgroup, row, columnheader
Keyboard navigation (ArrowDown/ArrowUp/Home/End) only operates within the currently-rendered virtualized window, not the full logical dataset, when virtualScroll/virtualScrollerOptions is active — a row outside the window is not in the DOM to focus. This is a real, intentional, already-shipped limitation of Table's Scroller composition, documented inline at the row-keydown handler in all three frameworks' own source.
### Related components
Paginator, Scroller

## Tooltip
Category: Overlay
Shows advisory content next to a host/target element on hover or focus. An attribute directive in Angular and Vue; a target-based component in React.
### ng API
- `uTooltip`: string | undefined
- `uTooltipPosition`: "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right"
- `uTooltipDisabled`: boolean
### react API
- `target`: React.RefObject<HTMLElement> | HTMLElement | string | string[]
- `content`: React.ReactNode | undefined
- `position`: "right" | "left" | "top" | "bottom"
- `event`: "hover" | "focus" | "both"
- `showDelay`: number
- `hideDelay`: number
- `disabled`: boolean
- `closeOnEscape`: boolean
- `autoZIndex`: boolean
- `baseZIndex`: number | undefined
- `id`: string | undefined
- `className`: string | undefined
### vue API
- `value`: string
- `disabled`: boolean | undefined
- `escape`: boolean
- `class`: string | undefined
- `fitContent`: boolean
- `id`: string | undefined
- `showDelay`: number
- `hideDelay`: number
- `autoHide`: boolean
